notes.title: Creators, Happy New Year 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9848493/2e2d73b6b4adcebdf5e3925059aea2e7511f35c7.png[/img]
❤️ Dear Creators!

2022 Year coming to an end and we are ready to step into what awaits us in 2023! With your constant support and love we have managed to achieve a lot of things! 
We hope that the outgoing year has been a success and brought you a lot of nice moments both with our Doodle Games, and in the Doodle Community.
For us this year was a year of preparation, constant development and Community building. And you were part of all these processes throughout the year!

It was not a secret, that our main priority was Doodle God Universe, and everything that surrounds it. We have gone a long way from the first PC version launch, till the large-scale public playtest and worldwide demo version release! Thanks to you, the game is developing in the right direction and is already quite different from what it was originally. This year we have collected so much feedback that it would be enough to develop a completely new game! Your ideas from challenges and activities, your view from the outside added motivation for us to develop and make the game better! Our Community on Discord and other platforms has grown rapidly throughout the year - from 0 we are now almost 11000 users on Discord! And that is just less than in a year. 

And now, what awaits us in 2023? Of course it is Doodle God Universe release https://bit.ly/3woNfWu - improved, with new features, new elements and new 3D scenes! In 2023, the World and the Community of Doodle God is set to get even bigger. More updates, more content: Episode 3 is coming! 
Of course we will not forget about our previous Doodle Games. In the coming year we will be releasing other Doodle Games to the Epic Store, Varenje will get a Playstation and Nintendo release, Worlds Builder will finally hit Steam! 

There is so much more we want to tell you about the future of our Universe, but today is the day of celebration! Needless to say, that we just wouldn't be the same without you, we are all together THE Doodle God Universe!  

From all of us at JoyBits - to all of you, Creators: We wish you a Happy New Year 2023! 
Next year is going to be lit 🔥

With love,
JoyBits Team

notes.title: Doodle God Universe: Speedrun Challenge
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40928613/e58cee7ebb3f4594869089c1a5e3d8766663e20f.png[/img]
[h2]🎮 To spice things up - we are launching a [b]Doodle SpeedRun Challenge on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y6sk8qyK3s]Discord[/url][/b][/h2]

[b]⏳Record how you start and finish our Demo as fast as you can and win Doodle God Universe key (pre-order list) [/b]

[h3]🏆 Prizes: [/h3]

[b]🥇 5 players[/b], who finished the game with the fastest time will get [b]Doodle God Universe Steam key (pre-order list) [/b]
🎁 All other players, who made a recording, finished the game, but the time was out of top-5 - will be randomly drawn into 5 winners of [b]Doodle God Universe Steam keys (pre-order list)[/b] 
❕ Everyone who will have valid entries - will get a role "Doodle SpeedRunner" on our Discord server!

[h3]❓ How to participate:[/h3]

👉🏻 Record your gameplay from [b]"Start to Finish"[/b] with no editing.
👉🏻 You need to set a visible timer on a screen (download any timer, we recommend the timer for speedrunners: [b]Livesplit[/b]).
👉🏻 The whole game screen must be shown, especially the timer.
👉🏻 What is considered [b]"Start to Finish"[/b]? Timer [b]START[/b] is considered, when you start from [b]"Open the group"[/b] screen in the main game [b](Evolution)[/b] . Timer [b]FINISH[/b] is considered, when you found [b]54 elements in the Evolution[/b] game and saw the [b]"Thank you for playing screen"[/b], AND when you finished the Sea Evolution (Fish) game, after what you saw a "Thank you for playing screen". 
[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] In order to finish the challenge, you [b]MUST create elements "Life", "Fish", "Dolphin" and "Whale".[/b] You [b]will not be able[/b] to finish the Sea Evolution without these elements and complete this challenge. 
❕ Just to be completely clear: to finish the challenge, you need to finish [b]BOTH Evolution game AND Sea Evolution game.[/b] 
👉🏻 Post that recording [b]on YouTube[/b] (it can be kept public or unlisted)
👉🏻 Post the link on our [url=https://discord.gg/Y6sk8qyK3s]Discord[/url], in #fest-speedrun 

[h3]‼️ Rules:[/h3]

1️⃣ You can submit your entries until [b]October 9, 10.00 CET[/b]
2️⃣ Cheating is bad 👀 
3️⃣ Rules can change anytime, in case of new circumstances
4️⃣ You need to fully comply with the [b]"Start to Finish"[/b] rules to have a valid entry
5️⃣ Well.. Have fun!

‼️ In case you already played the demo, and want to start from the beginning - you just need to delete Doodle God Universe Demo folder on your PC.

❓ How to do that:
%userprofile%\appdata\locallow\joybits

✅ Folder should be there - just delete it and start the game 🙂
